observations: Western Gateway's August 11 FID remains the newest material issuer project disclosure in cumulative evidence; KMI holds 35.1% and contributes existing SFPP assets to the proposed 1,300-mile, 230,000 bpd system.
No later material project-execution evidence is present in cumulative lineage, so novelty is not manufactured.
FID improves project certainty, while realized value still depends on permitting, construction, capital discipline, contracted throughput and incremental return economics.
Existing-asset contribution may reduce greenfield intensity but does not establish return profile without net capital and earnings disclosure.
